[!cgo] skip
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip

# Under -race, constant-size noscan placements call the region slow path
# instead of the inline bump sequence.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
env CGO_ENABLED=1

cd m
logos build -o fast.exe .
go tool objdump -s 'main\.regionBump8' fast.exe
stdout 'JA '
go tool objdump -s 'main\.regionBump512' fast.exe
stdout 'JA '
logos build -race -o race.exe .
go tool objdump -s 'main\.regionBump8' race.exe
! stdout 'JA '
stdout 'logosRegionAllocNoscan'
go tool objdump -s 'main\.regionBump512' race.exe
! stdout 'JA '
stdout 'logosRegionAllocNoscan'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/regionbumprace

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "logos/arena"

var regionSink int

type regionPad512 [512]byte

//go:noinline
func regionUse(p *int) int {
	*p++
	return *p
}

//go:noinline
func regionBump8() int {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	return regionUse(p)
}

//go:noinline
func regionBump512() int {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[regionPad512](r)
	p[0] = 1
	return int(p[511])
}

func main() {
	regionSink += regionBump8()
	regionSink += regionBump512()
	_ = regionSink
}
